abstract: Maintains formation borehole stability ratings and auxiliary casing advance metrics
system_message:
You are the Lead geotechnical engineer (GEOT), responsible for tracking rock mass borehole stability assessments and auxiliary casing advance rates along the proposed rescue drilling corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Core sample recovery（CORE）
information_points.content:
GEOT-CORE-T04：According to the geological exploration core registry across stratigraphic test boreholes along the rescue corridor, the Reverse-circulation percussion plan achieves a core extraction recovery ratio of 96%.
GEOT-CORE-JN4：According to the geological exploration core registry across stratigraphic test boreholes along the rescue corridor, the Down-the-hole turbo hammer plan demonstrates a core extraction recovery ratio of 82%.
GEOT-CORE-RIU：According to the geological exploration core registry across stratigraphic test boreholes along the rescue corridor, the Dual-rotary casing drilling plan exhibits a core extraction recovery ratio of 90%.

information_points.title: Maintains formation borehole stability ratings and auxiliary casing advance metrics（STAB）
information_points.content:
GEOT-STAB-U31：For the Down-the-hole turbo hammer plan, rock mass characterization records a geotechnical borehole stability index of 60 points along the rescue borehole path, alongside an auxiliary casing advance rate of 10 m/d.
GEOT-STAB-CNJ：For the Reverse-circulation percussion plan, the geotechnical borehole stability index is evaluated at 72 points within the stratigraphic column enclosing the rescue borehole path, while the auxiliary casing advance rate for the telescoping steel string is 14 m/d.
GEOT-STAB-A25：For the Dual-rotary casing drilling plan, the rock mass characterization assessment within the stratigraphic column enclosing the rescue borehole path indicates a geotechnical borehole stability index of 88 points, and the casing shoe driving analysis confirms an auxiliary casing advance rate of 6 m/d.
